title: The canonical derived section comparison at the tensor unit
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, let g:X→S and p:S→X be morphisms of schemes, and let h:g≫p=𝟙 X. Use the total module-object derived pullbacks of sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull and their canonical derived tensor units of def-sfb-derived-tensor-modules. Let c:L(g≫p)^*≅Lp^*⋙Lg^* be the canonical pullback compositor, t:L(g≫p)^*≅L(𝟙 X)^* the equality isomorphism induced by h, and i:L(𝟙 X)^*≅Id the canonical identity comparison. Let s:Lp^*⋙Lg^*≅Id be identified with c.symm≪≫t≪≫i by its defining equality. Write e_f:Lf^*(𝟙)≅𝟙 for the canonical unit comparison. Then s.hom.app(𝟙)=Lg^*.map(e_p.hom)≫e_g.hom. No properness, finiteness or nonemptiness assumption is required.

proof.text: For endomorphisms f,k of X and h:f=k, equality induction shows that the canonical equality transport between their derived pullbacks, evaluated at the tensor unit and followed by the unit comparison for k, is the unit comparison for f. The Lean proof substitutes k and uses the identity composition law.

Apply the published identity unit equation at X and the published composition unit equation to g and p. At the unit, the compositor followed by Lg.map of the unit comparison for p and the unit comparison for g is the comparison for g composed with p. Equality induction from the first step identifies equality transport followed by the identity comparison with that same map.

Precompose the proposed equation with the invertible component of the compositor. Expand composition and inverse of natural isomorphisms. Cancel the compositor with its inverse, and substitute the two equations from the preceding step. Canceling that invertible component proves the desired formula. All three steps are proved in Lean; no new obligation is left.

Regard the compositor with its type expressed using the named total derived pullbacks. The supplied equality identifies s with this same canonical composite as a natural isomorphism. Equality of natural isomorphisms gives equality of their components at the unit; apply the component formula just proved. This keeps whole-functor comparisons separate from evaluation at an object.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalDerivedPullbackSectionUnit {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : X ⟶ S) (p : S ⟶ X) (h : g ≫ p = 𝟙 X)
    (s : moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ p ⋙ moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ g ≅
      𝟭 (DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))))
    (hs : s = (leftDerivedUpperStarComp Λ g p).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X ↦ moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ f) h) ≪≫
        leftDerivedUpperStarId Λ X) :
    s.hom.app (𝟙_ (DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))) =
      (upperStar Λ g).leftDerivedFunctor.map (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ p).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ g).hom
